description: TEST FIXTURE: config.pair.json with llm_third_opinion.enforce_disagree=false (2026-10-10 switch). A pair DISAGREEMENT no longer forces ask: the decision falls through to the regular pre-llm_third_opinion classification flow (LLM1's merge drives it). Everything else byte-identical to config.pair.json.
_comment_fixture: enforce_disagree lives ONLY in llm_third_opinion (the comparison owner); llm_second_opinion deliberately does NOT carry the key - pinning that it is not read from the LLM1 block. PF-10 asserts the compiled value; LT3-29..LT3-32 exercise the fall-through.
_comment_log_file_path: Same dir as config.pair.json so fullpipe log-contains assertions read this suite's newest entry.
_comment_trusted_programs: tool-a/tool-b: the all-trusted R2-skip block (LT3-14). src\Classifier.ps1: the D5 trusted-only disagreement case (LT3-19 / LT3-32).
_comment_system_paths: Required by the stage-2 path-guard (Test-GatedInvocationSafe) - without system_paths the compiled regex matches NOTHING. Windows entries are regex (not escaped by the loader) -> quadruple backslashes in JSON.

llm_second_opinion._comment: NO enforce_disagree key here - the switch belongs to llm_third_opinion only. base_uri = DISCARD PORT (mocked classify cases; LT3-33 fullpipe never reaches HTTP).

_comment_llm_third_opinion: enforce_disagree=false (2026-10-10): disagreement is still DETECTED (llm2.compare='disagree', effect='llm2-disagree-not-enforced') but NOT enforced - the decision falls through to the regular classification flow, exactly as before llm_third_opinion existed. Default when the key is absent: true (today's forced ask).

Linux.description: Minimal Linux domain (same shape as the llm-review fixture).
